title: Verify Service Manager can edit work order header fields
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (header fields are gated by Work Orders: Create and Edit per spec v33; this role has it).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order.
2. In the header, change the Customer and save.
3. Change the Asset and save.
4. Change the Lead Technician and save.
expected: All header edits are allowed and save successfully with no permission error.
